subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): per-agent / per-channel scoping for autoCapture and autoRecall

question: Should `memory-lancedb` add per-agent/per-channel ambient `autoCapture`/`autoRecall` overrides, and which config path should become the canonical plugin contract?
rationale: The source confirms the missing behavior, but adding agent/channel memory policy is a new compatibility-sensitive config and security boundary that needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow plugin config
options.body: Add plugin-owned override maps with global booleans as defaults, no core config policy, and focused tests for hook gating plus docs.

options.title: Defer until tool scoping lands
options.body: Wait for the related draft PR to settle explicit tool scoping before choosing the ambient override shape.

options.title: Reject ambient targeting
options.body: Keep ambient memory global/disabled and require explicit scoped memory tools or separate stores for high-sensitivity deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow plugin config
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned override maps with global booleans as defaults, no core config policy, and focused tests for hook gating plus docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest ownership signal across memory-lancedb config, recall behavior, docs, and shipped hardening decisions.
